main_text.p: Albinouano. Intentio: Vim fecisti.D.Non feci.Q.an fecerit? R. Quia vim facere, est manum alicuius oppugnan-di causa parare. At ego nō ne candi cuiusquam, sed salutis meæ tutandæ causa præsidiū habui. F.Imò vim facere est, quacúque de causa homines armatos habere. D.Vim'ne is fecerit, qui suæ tantum salutis tuendæ causa, præsidiū armatorum hominum in foro habuerit. Est& Rabirianæ [?] status generis eiusdē. Lex est: Qui magistratum populi R.violarit, perduellio iudicator. C. Rabirius cō sulibus ad arma vocantibus præstò fuit,

page.notes: Running head is decorative and hard to read; not transcribed with certainty. Handwritten marks in the left margin (beside "homines" and "Lex") are manuscript annotations, not print, and were left out. "Rabirianæ" is a reconstruction across a line break with no printed hyphen; marked [?]. "Q.an" has an unclear mark between Q and an; marked as printed. Text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page; no catchword or signature visible.
